source.sanitization: Known replay artifact only; local filesystem paths removed before inclusion in aoe-sim.

methodology.identity: Numeric DAT unit IDs are the stable identity. Localized strings are display-only.
methodology.base_stats: Base HP, attack, armor, range, speed, line of sight, reload time, and train time are read from the currently installed DAT for each player's civilization. The exact historical DAT for the replay build is not available for direct comparison.
methodology.technology_timing: Observed technology completion times come from resource_estimates.json and are estimates. DAT-derived automatic civilization technologies are placed at the completion time of their deterministically satisfied prerequisites.
methodology.effect_semantics: Supported effect operations are unit upgrade type 3 and attribute set/add/multiply operations 0/4/5 for HP, LoS, speed, reload, max/min range, train time, and packed normal attack/armor classes 3 and 4. Unsupported relevant operations are counted in unresolved.
methodology.unit_counts: The viewer groups economy.unit_completions by the current resolved unit-line ID at the selected time. Counts are production intent, not surviving units, and starting units are excluded.

confidence.automatic_civilization_technologies: applied_only_when DAT zero-cost/time modifications and prerequisites are deterministic
confidence.unresolved_effect_policy: unsupported relevant effects are counted and exposed instead of guessed

caveats: Research-adjusted reference stats use the currently installed DAT (Steam build 24094652); exact ruleset parity with replay build 180059 is not proven.
Stats are adjusted by known and deterministically derived automatic completed technologies only; unresolved DAT operations remain unapplied.
The artifact does not claim current HP, exact damage after bonus classes, visibility, pathing, stance, combat contact, queue cancellations, or survival.
Production counts are intent estimates from queue completions and exclude starting units.
